scopeDescription: 43 Philippine NCCA periods/days; 57 country-jurisdiction entries expressly listed as holidays by EU EURES 2026
warnings: EURES is an EU institutional secondary index, NOT the country government's legal instrument
Fixed Gregorian recurrence excludes obvious Easter/mobile holidays and official 2026 observed substitute dates
Country-specific legal calendar entries can share holiday names with other countries; identities are jurisdiction-scoped
Five non-English display locales are English fallback, not human translations
No invented establishment years or reviewed long-form history
